info.title: eru
info.description: A CLI tool for sharing knowledge files across projects via git-backed sources.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Pull a file from a knowledge source into this repo.

options.name: --tag
options.description:
Filter by tag; repeat for multiple tags (AND
semantics).

options.name: --source
options.description: Source name fallback when no source: prefix is used.

options.name: --collection
options.description:
Pull all files in a named collection (e.g. name or
source:name).

options.name: --target
options.description: Local directory to write files into.

options.name: --dryrun
options.description: Show what would be pulled without writing anything.

options.name: --global
options.description:
Write auto-created source to global config
(~/.config/eru/config.json).
help                  display this list of options.

options.name: --description
